_mint(address to, uint value) internal: increases totalSupply and balance.
_burn(address from, uint value) internal: decreases balance and totalSupply.
_approve(address owner, address spender, uint value) private: sets allowance.
_transfer(address from, address to, uint value) private: moves balances.
approve(address spender, uint value) external: approves msg.sender allowance.
transfer(address to, uint value) external: transfers from msg.sender.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint value) external: pulls allowance then transfers.
permit(...) external: EIP2612 signature based approval with deadline check.
getReserves() public view: returns reserve0, reserve1, blockTimestampLast.
_safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint value) private: low-level token transfer.
initialize(address _token0, address _token1) external: one-time token setup, factory-only.
_update(...) private: writes reserves/timestamp and accumulates prices with unchecked math.
_mintFee(uint112,uint112) private: mints protocol fee LP tokens from sqrt(k) growth.
mint(address to) external lock: adds liquidity and mints LP tokens.
burn(address to) external lock: removes liquidity and transfers underlying tokens.
swap(uint,uint,address,bytes) external lock: optimistic output transfer plus external callback.
skim(address to) external lock: transfers surplus balances to `to`.
sync() external lock: forces reserves to match balances.
createPair(address,address) external: deploys pair via create2 and initializes it.
setFeeTo(address) external: feeToSetter-only update of feeTo.
